audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 against 52.79% over 1290 games is consistent, and the mirror kept its side at the inverse.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet, the mirror, or their own whys — level 1 was Skill above a why that says you out-trade him, level 3 was Tryndamere above a why calling it a coin-flip, and 4-5 was Skill above a why saying K'Sante wins it.
audit.why: The mirror settled level 1 to Tryndamere, level 2 to Skill, level 3 and 4-5 to K'Sante, first item to Skill. Level 3 is genuinely his: Path Maker charges for reduced damage and dashes out with a knockback and stun on a 14s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rows flipped in matched pairs with ratings adjusted, and whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed his passive deals true damage and gave no cooldowns or ranges anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text for Dauntless Instinct says his abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next attack — no true damage. The kit file's trueDamage flag sits on Path Maker and Riot's description of that ability does not mention it either, so I trusted the description. The real numbers: Ntofo Strikes 3.5s at 450 range, pulling only on the second stack; Path Maker 14/13/12/11/10 at 600; Footwork a 525 dash and shield every 10/9.5/9/8.5/8; All Out 120s at rank 1, 250 range, and it explicitly reduces his own defenses in exchange for damage and healing.
audit.corrected: True damage removed from whys[3], spikes[2] and mid. breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and five phase whys rewritten around the real numbers, including the fact that in All Out his Path Maker no longer stuns.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out launching you through a wall was never mentioned.
audit.why: It knocks an enemy back through any wall in their path, so it can put you on the wrong side of terrain with no dash to get back — the Flash is for the wall, not the damage.
Executioner's Calling is already in report[8], and All Out is the healing it answers — the missing-interaction rule is satisfied once dosFull[0].d ties the buy to that form.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how K'Sante contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spin up fury on the wave. Ntofo Strikes needs two stacks to pull you, and he cannot land the pair through a minion wall.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when K'Sante's All Out is down.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes is 3.5s at 450 range — the pull lands on the second hit, so break the pair by stepping out.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so K'Sante must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Path Maker charges for reduced damage then dashes for a knockback and stun — 14s at rank 1, and the charge is your cue to leave.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Footwork shields him every 10s and Path Maker resets every 14s; between them he refuses every trade you can force before 6.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage answers his commit: All Out trades his defenses away for damage and healing, so your crits land harder on him in R form than they do out of it.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on All Out's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker helps you stick, but Footwork's shield and 525 dash still buy him the exit.

edits.before: Level 3 is a coin-flip: his W-charge stun all-in versus your ability to dodge and punish it.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: the Path Maker charge into a stun is a real all-in, and it is 14s.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour K'Sante — full Ntofo stacks and passive true damage let him win extended trades before your ult.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour K'Sante — the Ntofo pull plus a Footwork shield every 10s win extended trades before your ult.

edits.before: With a crit item your sustained DPS and lifesteal outscale his tank stats in a duel.
edits.after: First item is even: your crit DPS grows, but his shield and dashes still buy the exit.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. R survives it; out-crit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - All Out: 120s at rank 1 — it launches you back through walls, so hold Flash for the terrain, not the damage. - Path Maker: 14s at rank 1, stun on the dash. - Footwork: a 525 dash and shield every 10s.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. R survives it; out-crit. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: All Out buys him damage and healing at the cost of his own defenses — crit him harder in R form.

edits.before: His duelist mode. R survives it; out-crit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: All Out heals him and drops his defenses — carry Grievous Wounds into it.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The second Ntofo Strike is the one that pulls — break the pair and it never comes.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: In All Out his Path Maker no longer stuns, but the damage is higher.

edits.before: With a crit shard and Q sustain you out-DPS his tank stats; his passive true-damage on marks is his only real threat, so kite his Ntofo stacks and E away from the reset.
edits.after: With a crit shard and Bloodlust sustain you out-DPS his tank stats; his passive marks make his next attack hit harder, so break the Ntofo pair and spin away before that attack lands.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 tighten to a skill window — his level 3 W-charge stun into Q knock-up is a real all-in, and misplaying into his passive marks costs you true damage. Play the wave, dodge the W, and hold Spinning Slash (E) as a defensive escape until your ult arrives.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are his — the level 3 Path Maker charge into a stun is a real all-in on a 14s cooldown, and his passive marks make the attack that follows hit harder. Play the wave, leave on the charge, and hold Spinning Slash as your escape until your ult arrives.

edits.after: Break the Ntofo Strikes (Q) pair

notes: The packet's suspectName is real: wants.you[1] said 'Ntofo Strike' and the ability is Ntofo Strikes — fixed. Two damage-type claims were wrong and both are removed: Dauntless Instinct does not deal true damage (Riot says marked targets take more damage from his next attack), and the kit file's trueDamage flag on Path Maker is not supported by Riot's description of that ability either, so I did not carry it over. The whys[4] / spikes[1] pair still calls level 6 a flip to Tryndamere while the chart row reads Skill; the mirror did not touch that row so I left it rather than introduce a disagreement it would have to re-fix.
